description: A camera still image, as a short-lived URL or inline base64 according to the request's responseFormat, with the time it was captured

image.description: One binary media result (audio or image). Exactly one of `data` (base64, inline) or `url` (a short-lived Port OS URL with its `expiresAt`) is present; the host rejects a result that carries both or neither. A plugin may return the vendor's fetchable `url` without `expiresAt`; the host always fetches it, republishes or inlines the bytes as the caller's `responseFormat` asks, and fills `byteLength`, so callers never see a vendor URL.

mimeType.description: The media type of the bytes.

byteLength.description: Size of the decoded bytes. Always present on host responses.

durationMs.description: Duration of audio in milliseconds, when known.

width.description: Image width in pixels, when known.

height.description: Image height in pixels, when known.

url.description: Short-lived URL of the media (valid until `expiresAt`, at most 10 minutes).

expiresAt.description: When `url` stops working. Present with `url` on host responses.

data.description: Base64 encoded bytes, at most 10 MiB decoded.

image.title: MediaContent
